penalties_applied.name: b2c_at_scale_needed
penalties_applied.reason: The target (solo devs and 1-10 person teams seeking free/low-cost tooling) is a consumer-like segment with very low willingness to pay; revenue requires large volume.

rationale: The segment asking for this solution explicitly wants it free (the forum post asks for 'gratis' FOSS options), which is a clear signal of near-zero willingness to pay (score 2). The buyer is a solo developer or tiny team — the weakest paying buyer archetype. Total of 2.8 after penalties is far below the validate threshold. There is no commercial opportunity here worth pursuing.
solution_plan: Not recommended. The community explicitly signals it wants a free/open-source solution, and the segment (solo devs, tiny teams) has minimal software budget. Any paid product here competes directly with free MySQL audit plugins and enterprise tools the target segment can't afford anyway. This is a valid open-source contribution but not a revenue-generating micro-service.
notes: Fails willingness_to_pay_min (2 < 5) and buyer_clarity_min (3 < 6) build gates. Total (2.8) is well below validate threshold — drop.
